subject: Setup: Meridian Robotics - bank proof, PO remittance reference, and invoice format
messages:
From: Christine Albright <christine.albright@meridian.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding - banking proof + W9 (Meridian Robotics)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — attaching our bank letter and W‑9 to get Meridian set up for electronic payments. A few notes so your payments team can map remittance correctly:

- Legal name: Meridian Robotics, Inc.
- Remit-to email for invoices: payments@meridian.co (we can alias if you prefer)
- Preferred invoice reference: PO# followed by SKU (example: PO12345 / SKU-A13)
- Bank (US ACH): Bank of West
  - Account (last 4): **** 3210
  - Routing: 122000661
  - Account type: Checking

We will expect a micro-deposit verification before you enable ACH pulls. Also confirm whether you need a supplier code or a specific PO tag in your AP system — our finance ops needs that for reconciliation.

Attachments: meridian_bank_letter.pdf (bank letter, signed), meridian_w9.pdf (W‑9)

Looking forward to getting this live — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Christine Albright
Head of Finance Operations
Meridian Robotics
christine.albright@meridian.co
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Christine Albright <christine.albright@meridian.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - banking proof + W9 (Meridian Robotics)

Thanks Christine — received. Looping in Marissa and Ben from FinOps so we can complete vendor creation and PO mapping. Quick answers below:

- We will verify micro-deposit amounts and confirm once deposits clear (typically 1–2 business days).
- Preferred remit string in our system is: PO#: [PO_NUMBER] — InvoiceLine: [SKU] — we can map this to your example.
- Please confirm whether invoices will be sent to payments@meridian.co or to an invoices+redwood alias (we sometimes require invoices to route to invoices@meridian.co to preserve metadata).

I attached our internal PO tagging template link for reference: https://drive.redwood.com/finops/po-template-v2.xlsx

Next steps: Ben will run the micro-deposit once vendor is created; Marissa will provide the vendor code and PO tag to use. Will confirm when ACH is enabled.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - banking proof + W9 (Meridian Robotics)

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Christine — received. Looping in Marissa and Ben from FinOps so we can complete vendor creation and PO mapping.

Team — I started the vendor intake in NetSuite, but we need confirmation on two items before we finish:

1) Vendor tax classification: Christine attached a W‑9; confirm "C corp" vs any pass-through entity.
2) Remittance preference: Christine, if you can confirm a single remit-to address (payments@meridian.co) we'll set that as primary. If you plan to use an invoices+ alias, tell us the exact address.

Once Ben verifies micro-deposits, I will: create vendor record (vendor code: MRD-2027-061), set default payment terms NET30, and add a PO reference rule that prepends "PO" to the invoice reference and pushes SKU into the invoice line description field for reconciliation.

If NetSuite needs a structured remit tag, we'll use: REDWOOD_PO:[PO_NUMBER] | MRD:[INVOICE_ID]. Let me know if that collides with your AR processes.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of FinOps (AP)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Christine Albright <christine.albright@meridian.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - banking proof + W9 (Meridian Robotics)

Christine / Meridian team — good news, micro-deposits have posted and been verified: amounts $0.12 and $0.47. We have created vendor MRD-2027-061 in our AP system and enabled ACH credit/payments. Details below for your records:

- Vendor code: MRD-2027-061
- Default payment term: NET30
- Remit-to (for Redwood payments): payments@meridian.co (primary)
- Required invoice reference for automated reconciliation: include "PO:[PO_NUMBER]" in the invoice subject or invoice header; we will also accept "PO[PO_NUMBER] / SKU" in the line items.
- If invoices come via a different address please CC payments@meridian.co and invoices@redwood.com so our parser can pick up PO tags.

Attachments: vendor-setup-confirmation.pdf (system screenshot + vendor code)

Next steps for Meridian:
- Send your first invoice with the PO reference (example: PO:12345) to payments@meridian.co.
- If you prefer an invoices+ alias instead, reply with the exact alias and we will whitelist it for auto-ingest.

Welcome aboard — let me know if you want a short onboarding call to walk through invoice examples.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, FinOps
ben.carter@redwood.com
